'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Brian Herold DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
